name: Hullabaloo

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Classy Contender
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant class ability energy.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 18 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4NmtGbfgA5USVGjtqEcqps?si=17c11135a8cb4f39) with @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Raneiks Unified or future multiple-bodied bosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content. Hullabaloo is only one of two Compressed Wave Frame grenade launchers in game atm. At base, the stats are lowerby comparison with its only peer - 28 Velocity equates to 40.35m/s (although you're firing at your feet so isn't that important), 38 Stability is ×1.1242 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 41 Handling is 0.44s ready, 0.42s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, 39 Reload Speed is a 3.27s reload, Recoil Direction is 80 (but that doesn't matter), and base magazine size is 5 (max 7). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 25/27/28/29 (max 31). Use the barrel perk to bump up the Blast Radius, to widen the wave or, if you're swapping a lot look to boost Handling. For a boss roll against Bosses with multiple bodies, such as Raneiks Unified from the Vesper's Host dungeon, Field Prep provides a reserves mod worth of total ammo (2 when enhanced), and +50 Reload Speed (+55 when enhanced) and ×0.8 reload and handling animations when crouched. Alternatively, Envious Assassin can overload your magazine by as much as ×3, or you can bypass reload with Envious Arsenal. As the damage perk, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for 10s for hitting three enemies which is S-Tier for Raneiks' damage phase. Classy Contender is an unspectacular origin trait, generating roughly 5% class ability energy on kills. Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Handling with a Backup Mag mod. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

Adamsdown_Boy written v8.5.2.1 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Elites, Champions and Minibosses. Hullabaloo is only one of two Compressed Wave Frame grenade launchers in game atm. At base, the stats are lowerby comparison with its only peer - 28 Velocity equates to 40.35m/s (although you're firing at your feet so isn't that important), 38 Stability is ×1.1242 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 41 Handling is 0.44s ready, 0.42s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, 39 Reload Speed is a 3.27s reload, Recoil Direction is 80 (but that doesn't matter), and base magazine size is 5 (max 7). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 25/27/28/29 (max 31). Use the barrel perk to bump up the Blast Radius, to widen the wave or, if you're swapping a lot look to boost Handling. For a burst damage weapon, the trait perk combination of Demolitionist and Golden Tricorn to trigger the first stack of ×1.5 damage for 7s, proc the second stack of ×1.5 for 10s with a grenade, which also refills the magazine, and then regenerate grenade ability energy from kills, works well. Classy Contender is an unspectacular origin trait, generating roughly 5% class ability energy on kills. Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Handling with a Backup Mag mod. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Hullabaloo needed a bit of a buff to feel good and had some unique rolls the last time. If you managed to get them there's nothing to look forward to. All the rolls are basically identical. Voltshot and Chain Reaction are unique together and very fun. But I found myself gravitating toward Envious Assassin with Chain Reaction or Cascade Point." Recommended MW: Velocity.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "While I don't think many people will use the wave frame over a traditional GL in PvP, those same few will almost always catch someone off guard. I can count on one hand how many times I've died to a heavy wave frame GL in PvP and all 5 of those times were during Guardian Games. Impulse Amplifier will help keep the trajectory linear instead of arcing, and Golden Tricorn will just give you extra damage for if you're not quite as accurate on the second shot." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.
pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Velocity.
pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Velocity.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Oh this is gonna be fun. I love a large mag and Cascade Point. My Until It’s Return gets a lot of use due to being a better Fourth Horseman. This roll will get a ton of smiles clearing rooms and taking down beefier enemies with relative safety." Recommended MW: Velocity.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "While I don’t think anyone will be vying for this roll in PvP I think the best use case is a swap build. Not ideal for “wasting” heavy to not get the kill with it. But being a wave frame you won’t get a ton of direct hits to kill. If a guardian jumps it’s all over. Ideal for pubs, not ideal for most PvP situations." Recommended MW: Velocity.

SirStallion (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "This is a heavy GL.. So a pick like Chain Reaction might seem strange. However, with a base 28 grenades in the reserves, I will not be using this bad boy exclusively on bosses. Cascade point is a lot of fun too, but you don't get to finish out your 10 mag after Envious has kicked in. For champs and minibosses, the fight is often going to have plenty of adds to explode." Recommended MW: Velocity.

SirStallion (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "This weapon for PvP is tricky.. Wave frames are fun, but a heavy wave frame? Who knows, it might be a blast. And I intend to find out, by creating additional blasts and trying to utilise Chain Reaction to net some fun triple kills.. Or more. Imagine more.. It seems that Blast Radius really doesn't bring much to the table for wave frames, and I would assume that the heavy variant is much the same, so Im focusing on velocity to get my nades where they need to be ASAP." Recommended MW: Velocity.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 98 from 19 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0cxvW6vTZVWtwmXkqr7g1f?si=66932432408046d2) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. Only the second heavy wave-frame GL, so there's not a big pool to compare against, but it's noticeable that Hullabaloo has lower inventory stat than Dimensional Hypotrochoid, so you can't carry a many reserves and don't get as many shots per heavy brick. There's not much to tinker with stats-wise with the barrel and mag perks - we're looking for velocity, handling and reload speed. Field Prep in the first trait column makes up somewhat for the inventory stat, and when it's enhanced it's only one shot away from max ammo, without the need for any reserve mods (one would get you to the max). Chain Reaction in the second column makes this your heavy Forbearance for crowd control - you should be able to wipe out add-dense areas or spawns in end-game activities. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful - who would say no to extra class ability energy? Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Handling, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 98 from 19 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0cxvW6vTZVWtwmXkqr7g1f?si=66932432408046d2) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content, particularly with arc subclasses. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. Only the second heavy wave-frame GL, so there's not a big pool to compare against, but it's noticeable that Hullabaloo has lower inventory stat than Dimensional Hypotrochoid, so you can't carry a many reserves and don't get as many shots per heavy brick - you'll likely need to run some ammo reserve mods. There's not much to tinker with stats-wise with the barrel and mag perks - we're looking for reload speed, velocity, and handling. For a little arc synergy, but mostly for the extra jolt lethality, Voltshot is a very fun option for the first trait column, working with Sparks of Ions and Discharge from the arc kit. Chain Reaction in the second column makes this your heavy Forbearance for crowd control - with the two traits in combination, you should be able to wipe out add-dense areas or spawns of even beefy enemies in end-game activities. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful - who would say no to extra class ability energy? Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod.
